sloka: स शरैर्भिन्नसर्वाङ्गो गात्रप्रस्रुतशोणितः ।राक्षसेन्द्रः समूहस्थः फुल्लाशोक इवाबभौ ।। ६.१०४.३१ ।।
transliteration: sa śarairbhinnasarvāṅgo gātraprasrutaśoṇitaḥ ।rākṣasendraḥ samūhasthaḥ phullāśoka ivābabhau ।। 6.104.31 ।।

translations.english: Pierced all over the limbs with arrows, blood flowing from the limbs, he (Rakshasa king) appeared like an Ashoka tree in the gathering.
